meta.name: <PROJECT_NAME> On-Premises Deployment Specification
meta.author: SyncGlide Enterprise
meta.description: Standard architectural requirements, packaging bundles, security constraints, and operational workflows for deploying <PROJECT_NAME> in isolated on-premises enterprise environments.

core_principles: Zero-Knowledge First: server never handles unencrypted client secrets or private key material
Zero Source Code Shipped: only compiled binaries, container images, or minified static assets are distributed — no raw source
Air-Gapped Autonomy: zero required internet dependencies; licensing (if any) verified offline
Deployment Flexibility: support at least one containerized and/or one host-native install path
Auditability: security-relevant actions are logged with a defined retention period

compliance_checklist: No raw source code present on deployed hosts
